home.heroSubtitle: Discover, register for and organize chess tournaments across Georgia — from classical opens to fast online blitz arenas. One platform, zero paperwork.
home.trusted: Built for players, clubs and organizers
home.featuredSubtitle: Hand-picked events worth clearing your calendar for.
home.upcomingSubtitle: Find your next board, bracket or arena.
home.categoriesSubtitle: Chess leads the lineup. More competitive disciplines are on the way.
home.howTitle: From discovery to checkmate in three steps
home.howSubtitle: No Messenger threads. No spreadsheets. Just a clean tournament experience.
home.howStep1Text: Search by city, format, date or skill level. Every event lives on a shareable, SEO-friendly page.
home.howStep2Text: Fill in your player details once and track your registration status from your personal account.
home.howStep3Text: Organizers manage approvals and participants in one dashboard, so you always know where you stand.
home.benefitsTitle: Built like a professional tournament desk
home.benefitsSubtitle: The operational rigor of a tournament hall, in a modern web platform.
home.benefit1Text: Pending, approved, waitlisted or cancelled — always visible, always current.
home.benefit2Text: Atomic seat reservations prevent overbooking, even when registrations arrive together.
home.benefit3Text: Approve players, export CSV lists and publish events without leaving the dashboard.
home.benefit4Text: Georgian, English and Russian — including tournament content and validation messages.
home.recentSubtitle: Fresh events from organizers across the country.
home.ctaTitle: Ready to run your next tournament?
home.ctaText: Publish a professional tournament page, manage registrations and keep your players informed — all from one dashboard.
